description: Reads one automation in one of three views. details: its name, status, number, the live version, what it clashes with while it is on and, on request, its versions and recipe settings. versions: every version, newest first, one page at a time. stats: the chats it answered alone and handed over, by day, with the top hand-over reasons. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

expand.description: Comma-separated extras for view details: active_version, latest_version, ir, settings.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

range.description: For view stats: today or 7d. Defaults to today.

view.description: details for the automation itself; versions for every version, newest first; stats for how it did today or over seven days.

name: get_automation
title: Read one automation
